name: quantile_regression_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: OLS regression estimates the conditional mean, but traders care about extremes — what is the worst-case (5th percentile) or best-case (95th percentile) return given current conditions? Quantile regression estimates conditional quantiles: for a given set of predictors (VWAP distance, volume ratio, NIFTY return), what is the 10th and 90th percentile of the next 30-bar return? When the 10th percentile is positive (even the worst case is up), we have a high-confidence long signal. When the 90th percentile is negative (even the best case is down), we have a high-confidence short signal. The inefficiency exists because quantile regression is rarely used in trading; most signals estimate expected return, not return distribution quantiles.
mechanism: Institutional order flow arrives in bursts via algorithmic execution (TWAP/VWAP slicing), creating persistent directional pressure over 30-120 seconds. Retail and smaller participants follow the initial move, extending momentum before liquidity absorbs the flow and the order book rebalances.

conditions: QR_P10 > 0 (even 10th percentile forward return is positive — very high confidence long)
QR_Median > 10 bps (median expected return exceeds minimum threshold)
QR_P90 < 0 (even 90th percentile forward return is negative — very high confidence short)

exit.signal_exit: QR_P10 drops below 0 for longs / QR_P90 rises above 0 for shorts (confidence lost)

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; re-fit models daily if VIX regime changes significantly
filters.volume_filter: X_Vol_Ratio must be within training data range (no extrapolation)

weaknesses: Requiring QR_P10 > 0 for longs (10th percentile positive) is extremely restrictive — this condition may occur only a few times per day across the entire NIFTY 50 universe, severely limiting opportunities
The quantile regression model is fitted on 5 days of historical data and may overfit to recent market conditions — model accuracy degrades as the market regime drifts from the training period

Three predictors (VWAP distance, volume ratio, NIFTY return) may be insufficient to capture the complexity of forward return distributions — important features like volatility, spread, and order flow are omitted
prior_art: Koenker & Bassett (1978) quantile regression; Engle & Manganelli (2004) CAViaR for conditional quantiles; Taylor (2008) on quantile regression for VaR; intraday application to trading signals is novel
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
